mapper.select:
select info.PROD_ID ,INFO.PROD_NAME ,INFO.PROD_RE ,INFO.PROFIT_TYPE /**运作方式**/ ,INFO.SET_DATE eDate /**成立日**/ ,'南银理财有限责任公司' prodManager /**管理人**/ ,ACCT_CHNNAME prodTruster /**托管人**/ ,PINDEX.CAPITAL /**期末余额**/ ,PARTNER.PARTNER_NAME partner /**合作机构**/ from REP_PROD_INFO info left join REP_PROD_INDEX PINDEX ON INFO.PROD_ID=PINDEX.PROD_ID AND PINDEX.STATUS='E' and #{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE}=pindex.VALUE_DATE left join DIS_PROD_PARTNER PARTNER ON INFO.PROD_ID=PARTNER.PROD_ID AND #{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE} between partner.EFF_DATE and partner.EFF_END_DATE where REP_PROD_TYPE in ('01','02') /**母产品或者单产品**/ AND info.STATUS='E'
AND info.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select rownum ,info.PROD_ID ,rindex.ASSETS_VALUE ,rindex.UNIT_VALUE ,rindex.UNIT_VALUE_T from REP_PROD_INFO info left join REP_PROD_INDEX rindex on info.PROD_ID=rindex.PROD_ID and rindex.VALUE_DATE=#{reportDate,jdbcType=DATE} where 1=1
and info.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select rownum ,accts.PROD_ID ,accts.ACCOUNT_TYPE ,accts.ACCOUNT_NUM ,accts.ACCOUNT_NAME ,accts.ACCOUNT_OPENER from REP_INVEST_ACCOUNT accts where accts.STATUS='E'
and accts.PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
